description:
Create an animated GeoGebra construction demonstrating a cycloid — the curve traced by a point on the rim of a rolling circle. 

Starting from a blank project:
1. Create a numeric slider 't' ranging from 0 to at least 12.5 (approx 4π).
2. Construct a circle of radius 1 whose center moves along the line y=1 as the slider 't' increases. The center should be at (t, 1).
3. Create a point on the rim of this circle that traces the cycloid. Its position should be (t - sin(t), 1 - cos(t)).
4. Use the 'Curve' command to plot the full cycloid path for the range 0 ≤ t ≤ 4π.
5. Add a text annotation to the view labeling the curve.

Save your project as 'cycloid_animation.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
